The creator callback encapsulates all existing logic (ID generation, validation, WP detail construction, root index update). Added 6 unit tests for createWorkPackageWithSync in ledger-store.test.ts covering: atomic write of WP+root, last_updated auto-stamp, schema validation rejection (with no file written), callback error rollback, .meta.json sync, and return value. All 1424 tests pass.

No partial WP file write should occur in that case — the implementation is correct (validates root after wp before writing either), but a dedicated test would document this guarantee.
